howNsvx.heroHeading: Progress that earns. Depth that pays.
howNsvx.heroBody: NSVX is the AlphaGlow wellness token. Show up. Complete sessions. Hit milestones. The platform rewards the work — not the scroll.
howNsvx.spendDisclaimer: Token amounts are indicative and subject to change. See the {nsvxLink} for full details.
howNsvx.creatorFlowHeading: For creators: NSVX flows back to you.
howNsvx.creatorFlowBody: Every NSVX spent inside your creator program is split: a portion to the listener's session, a portion to AlphaGlow platform operations, and the majority back to you — the creator. Transparent, automatic, weekly.
howNsvx.faq1A: No. NSVX is a platform utility token — it exists only within AlphaGlow and has no external exchange value. It is not a financial instrument.
howNsvx.faq2Q: Can I sell or transfer NSVX?
howNsvx.faq2A: NSVX is non-transferable between accounts and cannot be sold or exchanged for fiat currency. It is earned and spent within the platform only.
howNsvx.faq3A: A portion of every NSVX spent inside a creator's program flows back to that creator — automatically, weekly. The exact split is disclosed in the Creator Agreement.
howNsvx.faq4A: Tokens earned through normal activity do not expire. Promotional tokens may carry expiry dates, which are disclosed at the time of award.
howNsvx.faq5Q: Where can I see my NSVX balance?
howNsvx.faq5A: Your balance is visible in the AlphaGlow app dashboard, updated in real time after each session.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1p: AlphaGlow AI ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding that information.
privacy.s2intro1: We collect information you provide directly:
privacy.s2i1: Account registration data (name, email address, password)
privacy.s2i2: Profile information (language preference, wellness goals, Nova companion settings)
privacy.s2i3: Wellness session data (completion records, streaks, check-in responses)
privacy.s2i4: Nova conversation history (used to personalize your experience)
privacy.s2i5: Payment information (processed by third-party payment providers — we do not store card details)
privacy.s2i6: Device type, operating system, and browser information
privacy.s2i7: Session timestamps and feature usage patterns
privacy.s3i1: To operate and improve the Platform
privacy.s3i2: To personalize Nova AI responses and creator recommendations
privacy.s3i3: To calculate and distribute NSVX tokens
privacy.s3i4: To send session reminders and wellness notifications (with your consent)
privacy.s3i5: To process payments and creator revenue distributions
privacy.s4p: Your conversations with Nova are stored to provide memory continuity and personalized coaching. We do not sell this data to third parties. Conversation data may be used in aggregate, anonymized form to improve AI model performance.
privacy.s5i1: Supabase — our database and authentication provider (EU Standard Contractual Clauses in place)
privacy.s5i2: Anthropic — AI model provider for Nova responses (data processed per Anthropic's API terms)
privacy.s5i3: ElevenLabs — voice synthesis for creator Digital Twin sessions
privacy.s5i4: Payment processors — for subscription and NSVX purchase transactions
privacy.s5p: We do not sell your personal data to advertisers or data brokers.
privacy.s6p: We retain account data for the duration of your account plus 90 days following deletion. Nova conversation history is retained for 24 months and can be deleted on request. NSVX transaction logs are retained for 7 years for financial compliance.
privacy.s7intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
privacy.s7i1: Access the personal data we hold about you
privacy.s7i3: Request deletion of your account and personal data
privacy.s7i5: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (EU/EEA users)
privacy.s7p: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@alphaglowai.app.
privacy.s8p: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. The Platform is a PWA and uses browser storage (localStorage/IndexedDB) for offline functionality.
privacy.s9p: Push notifications are opt-in. Your device push token is stored only for the purpose of delivering your requested wellness reminders. You can revoke permission at any time through your device settings.
privacy.s10p: Material changes to this policy will be communicated via in-app notification or email at least 14 days before taking effect.

aiDisc.title: AI Disclaimer
aiDisc.s1p1: Nova, the AlphaGlow AI companion, is powered by large language models (LLMs) provided by Anthropic (Claude). Nova's responses are generated algorithmically based on your inputs, your profile data, and the system context configured by AlphaGlow AI.
aiDisc.s1p2: AI-generated content is probabilistic in nature. Nova may produce responses that are incomplete, imprecise, outdated, or contextually inappropriate. AlphaGlow AI does not guarantee the accuracy, reliability, or completeness of any content produced by Nova.
aiDisc.s2h: 2. Not a Substitute for Professional Advice
aiDisc.s2p1: Nova is designed to be a supportive wellness companion — not a licensed professional. Nothing Nova says constitutes medical advice, psychological treatment, dietary prescription, or any other form of regulated professional advice.
aiDisc.s2p2: You should always consult qualified professionals (physicians, therapists, registered dietitians, etc.) before making changes to your health regimen, medication, or mental health treatment plan. See our Health Disclaimer for further details.
aiDisc.s3p: Nova retains conversation history to provide continuity and personalization. This memory is stored securely in our database and used solely to improve your experience on the Platform. Nova does not have access to external databases, the internet, or real-time information unless explicitly stated.
aiDisc.s4p: The AI models powering Nova have knowledge cutoff dates and may not reflect the most recent research, guidelines, or events. Nova may occasionally produce "hallucinations" — plausible-sounding but factually incorrect information. We actively work to mitigate this through system prompt design and output review, but we cannot eliminate it entirely.
aiDisc.s5p: Digital Twin sessions are AI-generated experiences modeled on creator-provided scripts, personas, and guidance frameworks. They are not live interactions with the creator. The creator has reviewed and approved the framework for their Digital Twin, but individual AI-generated responses within sessions are not pre-screened by the creator.
aiDisc.s6p: Nova is not equipped to handle mental health emergencies. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, suicidal thoughts, or a medical emergency, please contact emergency services (911 in the US), the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or your local emergency services immediately. Nova will remind you of these resources when crisis signals are detected, but this is not a substitute for real help.
aiDisc.s7p: Anonymized, aggregated conversation patterns may be used internally to improve system prompt quality and AI behavior. Individual conversations are not shared with Anthropic for model training without explicit consent, in accordance with Anthropic's API terms.
aiDisc.s8p: Questions about our AI systems: ai@alphaglowai.app.

healthDisc.title: Health Disclaimer
healthDisc.s1p: The content on AlphaGlow AI — including sessions, programs, creator content, Nova AI responses, soundscapes, and any other material on the Platform — is provided for general informational and wellness purposes only. It does not constitute, and should not be treated as, medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or a medical recommendation of any kind.
healthDisc.s2p1: Before beginning any new wellness practice, exercise program, dietary change, breathing technique, meditation practice, or other health-related activity introduced through this Platform, you should consult a qualified healthcare provider who is familiar with your individual health situation.
healthDisc.s2p2: This is especially important if you have or suspect you may have any physical or mental health condition, take prescription medication, are pregnant, or have recently undergone surgery or medical treatment.
healthDisc.s3p: Use of AlphaGlow AI does not create a doctor-patient, therapist-client, or any other professional care relationship between you and AlphaGlow AI, Nova, or any creator on the Platform — regardless of whether a creator holds professional credentials.
healthDisc.s4p1: AlphaGlow AI offers wellness support tools that may be beneficial for stress management, mindfulness, and general emotional wellbeing. These tools are not a substitute for professional mental health treatment, therapy, counseling, or psychiatric care.
healthDisc.s4p2: If you are experiencing symptoms of depression, anxiety, trauma, or any other mental health condition that significantly affects your daily functioning, please seek help from a licensed mental health professional.
healthDisc.s5p1: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger or experiencing a medical or mental health emergency, call your local emergency number (911 in the US) immediately. For mental health crises, the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline is available 24/7 by call or text.
healthDisc.s5p2: AlphaGlow AI is not equipped to respond to emergencies.
healthDisc.s6p: Wellness outcomes vary significantly between individuals. Any testimonials, results, or success stories shared on the Platform represent individual experiences and are not typical results. AlphaGlow AI makes no guarantees regarding specific health or wellness outcomes from using the Platform.
healthDisc.s7p: Some creator programs may include physical movement, breathwork, or other activities that carry inherent physical risk. Participate within your physical limits. Stop immediately and seek medical attention if you experience pain, dizziness, shortness of breath, or any other concerning symptoms.
healthDisc.s8p: AlphaGlow AI reviews creator applications, but does not verify, validate, or guarantee the credentials, licenses, or qualifications of any creator. Creator-provided content reflects the individual creator's approach and expertise and has not been reviewed or approved by AlphaGlow AI's medical or clinical advisors.

creatorAgreement.s2i4: Promptly update or remove content that becomes inaccurate or harmful
creatorAgreement.s2i5: Comply with all applicable laws in your jurisdiction, including consumer protection and healthcare regulations
creatorAgreement.s2i6: Respond to AlphaGlow AI inquiries regarding listener concerns within 5 business days
creatorAgreement.s3p: You retain ownership of all original content you upload to the Platform. By publishing content, you grant AlphaGlow AI a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to host, display, distribute, and deliver your content to listeners via the Platform, including through Nova AI personalization and Digital Twin sessions you have authorized.
creatorAgreement.s4p1: AlphaGlow AI distributes a portion of NSVX tokens spent within your program back to you. The current creator revenue share is 70% of all NSVX tokens spent inside your programs, with 30% retained by AlphaGlow AI for platform operations.
creatorAgreement.s4p2: Revenue distributions are processed weekly to the payment method on file. Minimum payout threshold: 500 NSVX equivalent. NSVX-to-payout conversion rates are set by AlphaGlow AI and may change with 30 days' notice.
creatorAgreement.s5p: If you authorize a Digital Twin session, you grant AlphaGlow AI permission to create an AI-modeled interactive version of your program. You must provide the script framework, persona guidelines, and bounds for the Digital Twin. You are responsible for reviewing and approving the Digital Twin configuration before it is published.
creatorAgreement.s6i1: Medical diagnoses, prescriptions, or clinical treatment protocols
creatorAgreement.s6i5: Unsubstantiated health claims that violate FTC, ASA, or equivalent guidelines
creatorAgreement.s6i6: Content promoting dangerous or illegal activities
creatorAgreement.s6i7: Third-party intellectual property used without authorization
creatorAgreement.s7p: AlphaGlow AI reserves the right to review, modify, suspend, or remove creator programs at any time if we determine they violate this Agreement, our platform guidelines, or applicable law. We will notify you of material removals where feasible.
creatorAgreement.s8p: Either party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days' written notice. AlphaGlow AI may terminate immediately for material breaches. Upon termination, your programs are removed from the Platform and pending NSVX distributions processed within 60 days.
creatorAgreement.s9i1: You have the right to publish all content you upload
creatorAgreement.s9i2: Your content does not infringe any third-party rights
creatorAgreement.s9i3: Any credentials or qualifications you claim are accurate and current
creatorAgreement.s9i4: You will comply with all applicable laws governing your wellness practice
creatorAgreement.s10p: AlphaGlow AI is not liable for listener outcomes resulting from your programs. You are solely responsible for the wellness advice, guidance, or content you provide. You agree to indemnify AlphaGlow AI against claims arising from your content or your violation of this Agreement.

nsvxDisc.title: NSVX Disclaimer
nsvxDisc.s1p: NSVX is a platform utility token issued and operated solely by AlphaGlow AI. It exists exclusively within the AlphaGlow platform ecosystem and is designed to reward consistent wellness engagement and enable access to premium platform content.
nsvxDisc.s2i2: A security, investment, or financial instrument of any kind
nsvxDisc.s2i3: Legal tender or a substitute for currency
nsvxDisc.s2i4: A commodity, share, bond, or derivative
nsvxDisc.s2i5: Eligible for trading on any exchange, platform, or marketplace
nsvxDisc.s3p: NSVX has no monetary value outside the AlphaGlow platform. You cannot sell, trade, or exchange NSVX for fiat currency, cryptocurrency, or any other asset with monetary value. Any third-party service claiming to exchange NSVX for money is unauthorized and potentially fraudulent.
nsvxDisc.s4p: NSVX tokens are bound to your AlphaGlow account and cannot be transferred to another account, sold, gifted, or inherited. Attempts to transfer NSVX outside authorized platform mechanics (such as referral bonuses) will result in account suspension.
nsvxDisc.s5h: 5. No Guarantee of Value or Availability
nsvxDisc.s5p: AlphaGlow AI reserves the right to modify the NSVX earning structure, spending rates, available redemptions, and token supply at any time. NSVX balances may be adjusted in the event of platform restructuring, program discontinuation, or other operational changes. AlphaGlow AI is not obligated to maintain any specific token value or spending opportunity.
nsvxDisc.s6p: Your NSVX balance is forfeited upon account termination, whether initiated by you or by AlphaGlow AI. Tokens earned through fraudulent activity (bot usage, manipulation of session tracking, unauthorized scripting) will be reversed and may result in account termination.
nsvxDisc.s7p: Creator distributions paid in fiat currency equivalent are based on NSVX flows within creator programs. These distributions are not guaranteed income. Creator payouts are calculated based on rates set by AlphaGlow AI and are subject to change with 30 days' advance notice. Creators are responsible for their own tax obligations on platform income.
nsvxDisc.s8p: AlphaGlow AI designs the NSVX system to comply with applicable laws and regulations. However, the regulatory treatment of digital platform tokens varies by jurisdiction. If you have concerns about how NSVX is treated in your jurisdiction, consult a qualified legal or financial advisor before participating.
nsvxDisc.s9p: Nothing on the AlphaGlow platform constitutes investment advice. Participation in the NSVX system is for wellness engagement purposes only and should not be considered a financial strategy of any kind.
